summary: FRONTEND-ONLY test (mobile 390x844, public preview) of the store-reviewer demo account login flow. ALL 6 REQUESTED FLOWS PASS: (1) demo@heraapp.com on email stage -> switches to 'Demo Sign In' password stage, NO OTP sent, 'Use a different email' link visible. (2) Correct password HeraDemo2024! -> signInWithPassword -> POST /api/auth/login 200 -> navigated to /subscription, which then routed premium account straight to the tabs home screen ('/' — main app, no blocking paywall). (3) Wrong password 'nope' -> themed alert 'Sign In Failed' + exact message 'Incorrect email or password. Please try again.', stays on password stage after OK dismiss, password field cleared. (4) 'Use a different email' link returns to 'Welcome Back' email stage, password field removed. (5) REGRESSION PASS: delivered@resend.dev still goes through the OTP stage ('Check Your Email' + 4-digit code input + Resend cooldown) — OTP flow unaffected. (6) Premium confirmed: backend login response has is_premium:true (curl-verified this session: 200 + token), and post-login the app landed on the tabs home screen without a paywall block. Backend spot-checks also pass: wrong password -> 401 'Incorrect email or password'. No red screens, no broken navigation.

'shadow*'/'textShadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow/textShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated, useNativeDriver fallback warning — pre-existing, web-preview only, non-blocking.

returnTo param defaults to '/subscription' (login.tsx:216); premium server bypass means the paywall does not block — app landed on tabs home screen. Both acceptable per spec.
No deprecated expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch usage in login.tsx.
